label: Philip J. Klass
narrative: Philip J. Klass is load-bearing on this board in at least two clusters now, and building him once here saves every later pass from citing an unnamed sceptic. His Skeptics UFO Newsletter #68 of Summer 2001 is the contemporaneous critical record of the Disclosure Project's press conference, and it does two things no other opened document does: it prints Clifford Stone's assignment history, which Klass obtained from the National Personnel Records Center in St. Louis, and it quotes the FAA Alaskan Region's press release of 5 March 1987 and the air traffic control transcript on JAL 1628 at length. He is an interested party and he is a rigorous one about his own limits: he states in the same issue that he did not attend the press conference, that Greer had refused him admission to a similar event in 1997 and reportedly refused the Fund For UFO Research, and that his account of the event therefore rests on Greer's press releases, on Greer's 573-page book and on broadcast footage. That declared limitation applies to his reporting of the event and does not touch the records he obtained himself, and the board should keep the two apart. He is not a disinformation actor and no edge on this board should imply it.
